zara: FWIW I hit a weird failure in the onboarding sample app: tool function-call streaming + JSON mode + auth-refresh retry produces a quoted JSON string that breaks our schema parser. Repro is tiny.
julio: Can you paste the chunk you see in logs?
zara: Logged chunk looks like this (from the rehydrated stream):
```
"{\"tool\":\"lookup\",\"payload\":\"{\\\"id\\\":123}\"}"
```
Note the inner args are quoted, so the schema validator complains `expected object got string`. It only happens when a 401 triggers refresh -> resend.
ben: Likely double-stringify when we rebuild the stream buffer. Does the retry layer reassemble text chunks, then middlewares call stringify again?
zara: Exactly. I traced into sdk/retry.js: we stitch buffered chunks into a single string and hand that to the middleware chain. SchemaMiddleware assumes chunks are JS objects and does `JSON.stringify(chunk)` before sending to the parser. If chunk is already a stringified JSON string we end up with escaped quotes.
julio: Two quick approaches: 1) defensive parse in SchemaMiddleware before stringify: if typeof chunk === 'string' && looksLikeJson(chunk) then pass through as-is or parse; 2) change retry rehydrate to emit actual parsed objects instead of raw strings. Which is less risky for stable SDK?
ben: For a patch, option 1 is smallest. We'll add a helper `ensureObjectChunk(chunk)` that tries to JSON.parse string chunks and returns object when possible. Also add an opt-in flag `wrapTool(..., {toleratePreStringified: true})` for backcompat. We'll log a deprecation notice.
ci-bot: CI: added unit test devex/retry-jsonmode.spec failing (reproducer included).
zara: Please also update the quickstart note: older pinned SDKs (1.8.x) used in our sample templates will break unless they include the retry fix. Recommend sample-app use >=1.9.2.
julio: I'll prepare a minimal PR with test + fix + changelog entry. Can we add a small e2e that simulates auth refresh mid-stream? Jenkins already has a mock auth provider we can reuse.
ben: Agree. Backport request to 1.8.x repo too. We'll add a short multiline comment in retry.rehydrate explaining why we avoid re-stringifying a chunk that looks like JSON.
ci-bot: CI: tests passing on julio/rehydrate-fix, PR queued for merge.
zara: Thanks team 495 saved my demo for the new hire onboarding.
